text:
olivia-peopleops: Heads-up: we've published a handbook update + short checklist for the upcoming Performance Review cycle. Two changes to note: (1) calibration windows moved earlier (calibration week = 2026-05-11 to 2026-05-15) and (2) self-review deadline extended to 2026-05-04 for ICs who need extra time. Full page: https://handbook.redwood.com/perf/review-2026

kevin-eng: Thanks. Does the calibration change affect when managers submit ratings or just the internal scheduling?

harper-manager: Also want to know if pay pools/comp recommendations timeline shifted? We had comp sync on 5/20 last year.

olivia-peopleops: Short answers: managers still submit initial drafts by 2026-05-08 (same), calibration week is earlier to give People + Comp more lead time. Comp recommendation deadline moves up by 3 business days to 2026-05-18. All noted on the page.

kevin-eng: Great. Any changes to the review form/questions? We use the same guided prompts?

olivia-peopleops: Same questions, small tweak to the "Impact" prompt to ask for one measurable example. We've put an example sentence in the guidance.

harper-manager: Will managers get a roster of directs who haven't submitted self-reviews after the extension? That would help follow-ups.

pulse-bot: Reminder scheduled: self-review extension notification will go out tomorrow at 09:00 PT to employees who haven't started their review.

olivia-peopleops: Yes, managers get a completion CSV on 2026-05-05. Also publishing a 1-page manager checklist + a copy-paste blurb for team channels.

toni-peopleops: We'll run a short webinar on 2026-04-28 (30 min) covering calibration expectations and new timelines. RSVP link on the handbook page.

kevin-eng: Thanks, adding to our squad calendar. One small ask: can you add a sample phrase managers can use to nudge folks who are mid-projects?

olivia-peopleops: Done  added two templates: "Quick nudge" and "Deadline + offer to help". I'll post the blurb to #engineering and cross-post to #general later today. Ping me for edge cases (international timezone adjustments, comp anomalies).

harper-manager: Appreciated. This is helpful.

olivia-peopleops: TY everyone.
